values.name: The seller of tools, never fortunes
values.blurb: We equip practitioners; we never compete with them. If a feature idea requires selling readings to consumers, the idea dies in the meeting.

values.name: Compliance is craft
values.blurb: Guardrails, disclosure, and attestation aren't legal chores — they're the product. We hire people who find elegance in doing the careful thing beautifully.

values.name: Respect the lineage
values.blurb: Astrology and tarot carry centuries of tradition and communities with strong values, including skepticism of AI. We build with those communities, cite our corpora, and earn the room.

values.name: Small, sharp, honest
values.blurb: A near-solo company through 2027 by design. Everyone ships, everyone talks to practitioners, and our market map — flat demand curve and all — is published on our own website.

roles.title: Founding Engineer
roles.body: Second commit in the codebase. You'll own the storefront and payments surface end-to-end — TypeScript, a boring-on-purpose stack, and integrations with a licensed ephemeris core and a merchant-of-record rail. You'll talk to practitioners weekly.
asks: Full-stack depth with payments or marketplace scar tissue
Comfort building against regulation (SB 243, EU AI Act) as spec
Care for the communities we serve — curiosity over cynicism

roles.title: Practitioner Community Lead
roles.body: You run the founding circle: recruiting the 25, hosting the monthly cohort calls, turning practitioner pain into ranked roadmap, and representing us in communities that are — reasonably — wary of AI. Practitioners trust you because you're one of them.
asks: A working or recent practice (astrology, tarot, or adjacent)
Proof you can hold a community's trust online

roles.title: Compliance Counsel
roles.body: You keep the moat sharp: AI-disclosure statutes as they multiply across states, EU AI Act conformity, FTC posture, and the payments-underwriting file. You'll turn each new law into product spec within the month it passes.
asks: Comfort advising a lean company that treats compliance as strategy
Plain-English drafting — our policies are read by tarot readers, not GCs
